  v.category, 
  v.defaultbillingaddress, 
  v.defaultshippingaddress, 
  v.email, 
  v.entityid, 
  v.entitytitle, 
  v.isinactive,
  v.lastmodifieddate,
  v.custentitymes_scoped,
  v.custentitymes_last_updateat,
  v.custentityfuuz_recordid,
  v.custentityfuuz_location
FROM 
  vendor v 
WHERE
  v.id = ${$state.context.REQUEST.DATA.id}
`

    scac
    customData
    integrationData
    supplierStatusId
    supplierTypeId
  }
}

mutation Mutation($payload: [SupplierUpdatePayloadInput!]!) {
  updateSupplier(payload: $payload) {
    id
    code

    dunsNumber
    externalId
    name
    scac
    customData
    integrationData
    supplierStatusId
    supplierTypeId
  }
}

data.transform:

WHERE entity = ${$state.context.REQUEST.DATA.id}
`

nodes.name: Create Update and Inactivate Supplier Addresses

data.mutation:
mutation Mutation($createPayload: [SupplierAddressCreatePayloadInput!]!, $updatePayload: [SupplierAddressUpdatePayloadInput!]!, $inactivatePayload: [SupplierAddressUpdatePayloadInput!]!) {
  create: createSupplierAddress(payload: $createPayload) {
    id
    code
    active
    defaultBilling
    defaultShipping
    main
    addressee
    externalId
    plantIdentifier
    customData
    integrationData
    supplierId
  }
  update: updateSupplierAddress(payload: $updatePayload) {
    id
    code
    active
    defaultBilling
    defaultShipping
    main
    addressee
    externalId
    plantIdentifier
    customData
    integrationData
    supplierId
  }
  inactivate: updateSupplierAddress(payload: $inactivatePayload) {
    id
    code
    active
    defaultBilling
    defaultShipping
    main
    addressee
    externalId
    plantIdentifier
    customData
    integrationData
    supplierId
  }
}

data.transform:
(

{
  "createPayload":$state.context.REMOTE.supplierAddress.{"create":{
    "code": addressee & " (" & $string(nkey) & ")",
    "addressee":addressee,
    "supplierId": $state.context.LOCAL.supplier.id,
    "externalId":nkey.$string(),
    "address": {
      "lines": [addr1 & "",addr2, addr3],
      "city": city & "",
      "state": state & "",
      "postalCode": zip & "",
      "country": country & ""
    },
    "defaultBilling": defaultbilling='T',
    "defaultShipping": defaultshipping='T',
    "integrationData":$}},
  "updatePayload": [],
  "inactivatePayload": []

}
)
